section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports preliminary analyses and validation of the BAS-2 scale across Study 2 and Study 3. Study 2 includes college students (women n=161, men n=102) and MTurk community participants (women n=150, men n=167), while Study 3 includes MTurk community participants (women n=192, men n=190). The BAS-2 showed significant negative correlations with BMI in both college (r=-.33) and community (r=-.39) samples, with gender-specific correlations reported separately. Measurement invariance testing confirmed the BAS-2's unidimensional factor structure across sex and sample type.
